'''M-4D0''', also known as '''Fourdee''', was a golden [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served as a porter droid aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]]''. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Systems Infiltration Manager]] took over the liner and as a result many of the on-board [[Droid/Legends|droids]] attacked the passengers and crew. M-4D0 used a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to shatter a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] and was instantly sucked out.
